mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_case c JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id

SELECT c.id AS id, c.case_no AS caseNo, c.patient_id AS patientId, p.patient_no AS patientNo, c.patient_code AS patientCode, c.patient_age AS patientAge, c.patient_gender AS patientGender, c.eye_side AS eyeSide, c.status AS status, c.workflow_status AS workflowStatus, c.diagnosis_note AS diagnosisNote, c.created_by AS createdBy, u.real_name AS createdByName, c.assigned_doctor_id AS assignedDoctorId, d.real_name AS assignedDoctorName, d.professional_no AS assignedDoctorProfessionalNo, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM medical_case c JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.created_by LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON d.id = c.assigned_doctor_id
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT c.id AS id, c.case_no AS caseNo, c.patient_id AS patientId, p.patient_no AS patientNo, c.patient_code AS patientCode, c.patient_age AS patientAge, c.patient_gender AS patientGender, c.eye_side AS eyeSide, c.status AS status, c.workflow_status AS workflowStatus, c.diagnosis_note AS diagnosisNote, c.created_by AS createdBy, u.real_name AS createdByName, c.assigned_doctor_id AS assignedDoctorId, d.real_name AS assignedDoctorName, d.professional_no AS assignedDoctorProfessionalNo, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM medical_case c JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = c.patient_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.created_by LEFT JOIN sys_user d ON d.id = c.assigned_doctor_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
